2026-07-06T09:52:10.201Z info  config: HTTP_PORT resolved to 8081 from env
2026-07-06T09:52:10.204Z info  kafka: connected to 2 brokers
2026-07-06T09:52:10.309Z info  http: binding 0.0.0.0:8081
2026-07-06T09:52:10.310Z warn  http: probe port mismatch — probes target 8080 but server bound 8081
2026-07-06T09:52:24.552Z info  envoy-sidecar: inbound listener claims :8080
2026-07-06T09:52:41.007Z error http: healthz self-check failed after 30s
Error: failed to bind :8080 (address reserved by sidecar inbound listener)
    at Server.listenOnPrimary (/app/dist/http/server.js:214:19)
container backoff: CrashLoopBackOff (restart 7)

There it is: the app binds 8081 (stray HTTP_PORT override) while probes expect 8080, and its 8080 self-check fails because the envoy sidecar's inbound listener reserved :8080. Checking whether the old ReplicaSet is still carrying traffic before I fix.

input.command: kubectl get pods -n staging -l app=orders-service -o json

content.text: Root cause confirmed: v2.31.0 introduced HTTP_PORT=8081 while probes and the mesh inbound listener still assume 8080 — the app and the sidecar fight over :8080 and readiness never passes. The old v2.30.4 pods are keeping the service alive. Fix: drop the HTTP_PORT override so the app binds 8080, and move the sidecar inbound listener to the mesh default :15006.

input.command: kubectl patch deployment orders-service -n staging --type json -p '[{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/3"}]' && helm upgrade orders-service ./helm/orders-service -n staging --set sidecars.envoy.inboundPort=15006 --reuse-values
